END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reorder_pages(_updates jsonb)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  ids uuid[];
BEGIN
  ids := ARRAY(
    SELECT (elem->>'id')::uuid
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(_updates) AS u(elem)
  );

  -- temporary shift to avoid unique constraint conflict
  UPDATE pages
  SET order_index = order_index + 1000
  WHERE id = ANY(ids);

  -- apply final order
  UPDATE pages AS p
  SET order_index = (u.elem->>'order_index')::integer
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(_updates) AS u(elem)
  WHERE p.id = (u.elem->>'id')::uuid;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.move_page(
  _page_id uuid,
  _new_parent_id uuid,
  _new_order_index integer
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _old_parent_id uuid;
  _old_order_index integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT parent_id, order_index
  INTO _old_parent_id, _old_order_index
  FROM pages
  WHERE id = _page_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Page % introuvable', _page_id;
  END IF;

  -- Compact old parent siblings
  UPDATE pages
  SET order_index = order_index - 1
  WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _old_parent_id
    AND order_index > _old_order_index
    AND id <> _page_id;

  -- Temporarily move page to new parent with sentinel order to avoid conflicts
  UPDATE pages
  SET parent_id = _new_parent_id,
      order_index = -1
  WHERE id = _page_id;

  -- Make room in new parent siblings
  UPDATE pages
  SET order_index = order_index + 1
  WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _new_parent_id
    AND order_index >= _new_order_index
    AND id <> _page_id;

  -- Final order for moved page
  UPDATE pages
  SET order_index = _new_order_index
  WHERE id = _page_id;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.move_page(uuid, uuid, integer) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.move_page(
  _page_id uuid,
  _new_parent_id uuid,
  _new_order_index integer
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _old_parent_id uuid;
  _old_order_index integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT parent_id, order_index
  INTO _old_parent_id, _old_order_index
  FROM pages
  WHERE id = _page_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Page % introuvable', _page_id;
  END IF;

  -- Compact old parent siblings
  UPDATE pages
  SET order_index = order_index - 1
  WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _old_parent_id
    AND order_index > _old_order_index
    AND id <> _page_id;

  -- Re-index old parent siblings to keep sequence tight
  WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY order_index) - 1 AS rn
    FROM pages
    WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _old_parent_id AND id <> _page_id
  )
  UPDATE pages AS p
  SET order_index = ordered.rn
  FROM ordered
  WHERE p.id = ordered.id;

  -- Avoid unique conflicts in target parent by shifting temporarily
  UPDATE pages
  SET order_index = order_index + 1000
  WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _new_parent_id
    AND id <> _page_id;

  -- Move page to target parent with temporary offset
  UPDATE pages
  SET parent_id = _new_parent_id,
      order_index = _new_order_index + 1000
  WHERE id = _page_id;

  -- Re-index target parent including moved page
  WITH ordered_target AS (
    SELECT id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY order_index) - 1 AS rn
    FROM pages
    WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _new_parent_id
  )
  UPDATE pages AS p
  SET order_index = ordered_target.rn
  FROM ordered_target
  WHERE p.id = ordered_target.id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.move_page(
  _page_id uuid,
  _new_parent_id uuid,
  _new_order_index integer
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _old_parent_id uuid;
  _old_order_index integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT parent_id, order_index
  INTO _old_parent_id, _old_order_index
  FROM pages
  WHERE id = _page_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Page % introuvable', _page_id;
  END IF;

  -- Reorder old parent siblings
  UPDATE pages
  SET order_index = order_index - 1
  WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _old_parent_id
    AND order_index > _old_order_index
    AND id <> _page_id;

  WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY order_index) - 1 AS rn
    FROM pages
    WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _old_parent_id AND id <> _page_id
  )
  UPDATE pages AS p
  SET order_index = ordered.rn
  FROM ordered
  WHERE p.id = ordered.id;

  -- Shift target siblings from the bottom to avoid conflicts
  WITH target AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM pages
    WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _new_parent_id
      AND id <> _page_id
    ORDER BY order_index DESC
  )
  UPDATE pages AS p
  SET order_index = order_index + 1000
  FROM target
  WHERE p.id = target.id;

  UPDATE pages
  SET parent_id = _new_parent_id,
      order_index = _new_order_index + 1000
  WHERE id = _page_id;

  -- Re-index target parent after inserting moved page
  WITH ordered_target AS (
    SELECT id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY order_index) - 1 AS rn
    FROM pages
    WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _new_parent_id
  )
  UPDATE pages AS p
  SET order_index = ordered_target.rn
  FROM ordered_target
  WHERE p.id = ordered_target.id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.move_page(
  _page_id uuid,
  _new_parent_id uuid,
  _new_order_index integer
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _old_parent_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT parent_id
  INTO _old_parent_id
  FROM pages
  WHERE id = _page_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Page % introuvable', _page_id;
  END IF;

  -- Move page to target parent immediately with sentinel order to avoid conflicts
  UPDATE pages
  SET parent_id = _new_parent_id,
      order_index = -1
  WHERE id = _page_id;

  -- Re-index former parent siblings
  WITH ordered_old AS (
    SELECT id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY order_index) - 1 AS rn
    FROM pages
    WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _old_parent_id
  )
  UPDATE pages AS p
  SET order_index = ordered_old.rn
  FROM ordered_old
  WHERE p.id = ordered_old.id;

  -- Shift siblings in target parent to make room
  WITH target AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM pages
    WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _new_parent_id
      AND id <> _page_id
      AND order_index >= _new_order_index
    ORDER BY order_index DESC
  )
  UPDATE pages AS p
  SET order_index = order_index + 1000
  FROM target
  WHERE p.id = target.id;

  -- Assign provisional order to moved page above the gap
  UPDATE pages
  SET order_index = _new_order_index + 1000
  WHERE id = _page_id;

  -- Re-index target parent (including moved page)
  WITH ordered_target AS (
    SELECT id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY order_index) - 1 AS rn
    FROM pages
    WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _new_parent_id
  )
  UPDATE pages AS p
  SET order_index = ordered_target.rn
  FROM ordered_target
  WHERE p.id = ordered_target.id;
END;
$$;
